title: PicardExternalCoefficientsPushforwardCoproduct
statement: Let k be a field [def-weil-field], X,Y schemes [def-pc-scheme], and f:X -> Spec(k), g:Y -> Spec(k) morphisms. Assume X is quasi-compact and f has affine diagonal. Let F,G be quasi-coherent modules on X,Y [pqf-def-coherent]. Put E=pr1^*F tensor pr2^*G [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations]. The ordinary module direct image pr2_*E [pqf-def-cohomology] admits maps iota_i:G -> pr2_*E indexed by a type I in the schemes universe which exhibit it as a coproduct of the constant family G in the module-sheaf category [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Neither coefficient needs to be acyclic and Y need not be quasi-compact or have affine diagonal.

source.place: Tag 0BED, lemma-kunneth, affine-open calculation and degree-zero direct-image formula; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BED

proof.text: Choose the basis Module.Basis.ofVectorSpace of scalarObj f F at the top open, with its small index type I. Let P be the canonical presheaf-module coproduct of the constant family G.val. Apply the affine-basis comparison to obtain an isomorphism between P and the ordinary external direct image after restriction to all affine opens of Y.

Regard P and the direct image as constant functors from Discrete PUnit, and assemble the affine comparison into a natural isomorphism. Apply module_sheafification_iso_of_affine_restriction to obtain an isomorphism from the module sheafification S(P) to the direct image. Naturality for the constant parameter is checked by functor map_id and identity composition.

The module sheafification functor S is a left adjoint and preserves the canonical presheaf coproduct cofan. Its adjunction counit gives an isomorphism S(G.val) ≅ G. Precompose the sheafified colimiting cofan with the discrete family of inverse counit isomorphisms. Transport its apex along S(P) ≅ pr2_*E using IsColimit.ofIsoColimit and Cofan.ext. This gives the required maps G → pr2_*E and IsColimit witness, including an empty index type.

lean.statement:
theorem picardExternalCupCoefficients_pushforward_coproduct
    (k : Type w) [Field k] (X Y : Scheme.{w})
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    [CompactSpace X] [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal f)]
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [G.IsQuasicoherent]
    : ∃ (I : Type w)
      (ι : ∀ _ : I, G ⟶ (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage
        (pullback.snd f g).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)),
      Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk _ ι))
